comment: The eleventh semitone jack is dead: src/W.cpp:77 loops i from 0 to 9 over an eleven entry table, so order[10], the jack the panel marks 11, is never read. It is on the panel and can be clicked, so it gets a line saying so rather than falling back on the maker's tooltip; it is given no family and no props because nothing reads it. The maker's own list in the README names eleven transposing inputs. The module has no parameters. The panel prints IN, the numbers 1 to 11, and + and - on the two outputs.
